task: Remove the 'code' npm bin alias from package.json and add docs/MIGRATION.md with user migration instructions.

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: Breaking change: existing global npm installations retain a stale 'code' symlink that npm update does not remove; users must fully uninstall and reinstall
technical_risk.mitigation: Migration guide (docs/MIGRATION.md) documents the stale-symlink cleanup steps and alternative aliases

key_reasoning.reason: S (2) not XS because the removal is a breaking change for published npm users: existing global installs retain a stale 'code' symlink that requires a full uninstall/reinstall to clean up — real user-facing impact even though the code change itself is a single-line deletion with trivial rollback
S (2) not XS because the XS band requires no new files; docs/MIGRATION.md is a net-new file, which disqualifies XS even though only 1 file was modified
